items.title_en: Rural Roads Loan Agreement Ratification Proclamation
items.summary_en: Rural Roads Loan Agreement Ratification Proclamation (Proclamation No. 1430/2026), a proclamation, has been approved and is awaiting publication in the Federal Negarit Gazeta. Corroborated by 3 independent sources.
items.summary_am: አዋጅ ቁጥር 1430/2019 · ሁኔታ፦ የጸደቀ፣ በጋዜጣ የሚጠበቅ · አውጪ፦ የሕዝብ ተወካዮች ምክር ቤት · በ3 ገለልተኛ ምንጮች የተረጋገጠ።

sources.name: Ethiopian News Agency
sources.title: House ratifies loan agreement for rural roads (DEMO)
sources.excerpt: Addis Ababa, September 18, 2026 (ENA) - The House approved the Rural Roads Loan Agreement Ratification Proclamation No. 1430/2026 (DEMO) with a majority vote.

sources.name: Addis Standard
sources.title: Parliament ratifies rural roads loan (DEMO)
sources.excerpt: Lawmakers passed the Rural Roads Loan Agreement Ratification Proclamation No. 1430/2026 today after a short debate on debt sustainability.

sources.name: Addis Fortune
sources.title: Rural roads loan ratified (DEMO)
sources.excerpt: The Rural Roads Loan Agreement Ratification Proclamation No. 1430/2026, passed by the House on Thursday, finances 600 km of rural roads.

items.summary_en: Digital Commerce Proclamation, a proclamation, has been submitted to the House of Peoples' Representatives. Initiated by the Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration. Corroborated by 3 independent sources. One or more sources report a later stage (approved), not yet corroborated.

sources.title: Council of Ministers approves draft Digital Commerce Proclamation (DEMO)
sources.excerpt: Addis Ababa, August 3, 2026 (ENA) - The Council of Ministers in its regular session today approved the draft Digital Commerce Proclamation and forwarded it to the House of Peoples' Representatives for approval. The draft was prepared by the Ministry of Trade and Regional…

sources.name: The Reporter Ethiopia
sources.title: Digital commerce bill heads to parliament (DEMO)
sources.excerpt: The Council of Ministers has approved a draft proclamation on digital commerce and sent it to parliament. Lawyers said the bill would define the liability of platform operators for the first time.

sources.name: Addis Standard
sources.title: Lawmakers refer draft Digital Commerce Proclamation to committee (DEMO)
sources.excerpt: The House of Peoples' Representatives today referred the draft Digital Commerce Proclamation to the Trade and Industry Affairs Standing Committee for detailed scrutiny after a first reading.

sources.name: Ethiopian News Agency
sources.title: House approves Digital Commerce Proclamation (DEMO)
sources.excerpt: Addis Ababa, October 7, 2026 (ENA) - The House of Peoples' Representatives approved the Digital Commerce Proclamation with a majority vote at its regular session today.

items.summary_en: Fuel Price Stabilisation Regulation, a Council of Ministers regulation, has been approved and is awaiting publication in the Federal Negarit Gazeta. Corroborated by 3 independent sources.
items.summary_am: የሚኒስትሮች ምክር ቤት ደንብ · ሁኔታ፦ የጸደቀ፣ በጋዜጣ የሚጠበቅ · አውጪ፦ የሚኒስትሮች ምክር ቤት · በ3 ገለልተኛ ምንጮች የተረጋገጠ።

sources.name: Ethiopian News Agency
sources.title: Council of Ministers approves Fuel Price Stabilisation Regulation (DEMO)
sources.excerpt: Addis Ababa, September 29, 2026 (ENA) - The Council of Ministers approved the Fuel Price Stabilisation Regulation, which will take effect upon publication in the Federal Negarit Gazeta.

sources.name: The Reporter Ethiopia
sources.title: Cabinet passes fuel price regulation (DEMO)
sources.excerpt: The Council of Ministers approved the Fuel Price Stabilisation Regulation on Monday. Importers welcomed the clarity on margins.

sources.name: Capital Ethiopia
sources.title: New regulation to stabilise fuel prices (DEMO)
sources.excerpt: The Fuel Price Stabilisation Regulation approved by the Council of Ministers sets a new pricing formula and a reserve fund.
